```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(ggplot2)
library(data.table)
library(MASS)
library(lmerTest)
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(here))

options(scipen=999) # disable scientific
```


## set up & explanation ##

This dataset includes metadata, multimodal features, and human annotation of Perceived Message Sensation Value (MSV). Specifically:

1. video_id, timestamp, dimensions_height, dimensions_width, video_duration: the assigned ID for each video in the dataset, with the timestamp for published time, video dimensions (height and width), and video duration in seconds.
2. view_count, like_count, comments_count: the number of views, likes, and comments.
3. popularity: whether the video is created by a popular or ordinary account.
4. alternative_medicine, climate_change, covid, election, gmo, health, russia_ukraine, vaccine: whether the video is about a specific topic or not.
5. tempo, loudness, spec_centroid: audio features (tempo, loudness, sound brightness).
6. brightness, saturation, entropy, warmness, shotc_ps, shotd_ps: visual features (brightness, saturation, visual complexity, warmness, shot count per second, shot duration per second).
7. facec_ps, faced_ps, face_age, face_anger, face_disgust, face_fear, face_happiness, face_sadness, face_surprise: face features (face count per second, face duration per second, average face age, average facial expressions in anger, disgust, fear, happiness, sadness, and surprise).
8. n_evaluation, perceived_msv: the number of human evaluation of perceived MSV for each video, and the average perceived MSV for each video.
9. predicted_msv: predicted MSV using the computational measure of MSV.
10. perceived_msv_high_ss, perceived_msv_low_ss: the average perceived MSV for each video among high sensation-seeking and low sensation-seeking participants.
11. perceived_msv_high_age, perceived_msv_low_age: the average perceived MSV for each video among older and younger participants.

```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
df = fread(here("data/msv_df.csv"), data.table = F)
```

## Table S12 & Figure 2A ##
```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
model.1 = lm(perceived_msv ~ predicted_msv, data = df) # Table S12, Model 1
model.2 = lm(perceived_msv ~ predicted_msv + timestamp + popularity + video_duration + alternative_medicine + climate_change + covid + election + gmo + health + russia_ukraine + vaccine, data = df) # Table S12, Model 2
summary(model.1)
summary(model.2)

figure.2a = ggplot(df, aes(x=predicted_msv, y=perceived_msv)) + 
  geom_point(color = "#1D4A80", alpha = .5) +
  geom_smooth(method=lm, color="#FA7A06", se=TRUE) +
  xlab("Computational MSV") + ylab("PMSV") + ggtitle(" ") +
  theme(panel.grid.major = element_blank(), panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), aspect.ratio=0.9, legend.position = "none",
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 15), axis.title.x = element_text(size = 15),
        panel.background = element_blank(), axis.line = element_line(colour = "black"), panel.border = element_rect(colour = "black", fill=NA, size=1))
figure.2a
```

## Table S13 ##
```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
df.ind = fread(here("data/msv_df_by_participant.csv"), data.table = F)
df.ind$gender_female = ifelse(df.ind$gender == "Female", "Yes", "No")
df.ind$race_white = ifelse(df.ind$race == "White or Caucasian", "Yes", "No")

model.3 = lmerTest::lmer(perceived_msv ~ predicted_msv + (1|video_order) + (1|participant_id), data = df.ind)
model.4 = lmerTest::lmer(perceived_msv ~ predicted_msv + age + gender_female + race_white + education + income + sen_seek + (1|video_order) + (1|participant_id), data = df.ind)
summary(model.3)
summary(model.4)
```

```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
figure.s1.df.1 = data.frame(predicted_msv = rep(df$predicted_msv, 2), perceived_msv = c(df$perceived_msv_low_ss, df$perceived_msv_high_ss),

  scale_color_manual(values = c("Low Sensation-seeker" = "#3182bd", "High Sensation-seeker" = "#e6550d"), guide = guide_legend(override.aes = list(fill = "transparent"))) +

        legend.title = element_blank(), panel.background = element_blank(), 
        axis.line = element_line(colour = "black"), panel.border = element_rect(colour = "black", fill=NA, size=1))
figure.s1a
```

## Tables S18-S19 & Figure 2B ##
```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
df$engagement = rowSums(df[,c("view_count", "likes_count", "comments_count")], na.rm = T)/10000

# linear terms
model.5 = glm.nb(engagement ~ predicted_msv, data = df) # Table S18, Model 1
model.6 = glm.nb(engagement ~ predicted_msv + timestamp + popularity + video_duration + alternative_medicine + climate_change + covid + election + gmo + health + russia_ukraine + vaccine, data = df) # Table S18, Model 2

# polynomial terms
model.7 = glm.nb(engagement ~ poly(predicted_msv, 2, raw = T), data = df) # Table S19, Model 1
model.8 = glm.nb(engagement ~ poly(predicted_msv, 2, raw = T) + timestamp + popularity + video_duration + alternative_medicine + climate_change + covid + election + gmo + health + russia_ukraine + vaccine, data = df) # Table S19, Model 2

summary(model.5)
summary(model.6)
summary(model.7)
summary(model.8)

model_7_func <- function(x) {exp(-1.08*(x^2) + 7.25*x - 7.71)}

figure.2b = ggplot(df[which(df$engagement < 200),], aes(x=predicted_msv, y=engagement)) + 
  geom_point(color = "#1D4A80", alpha = .5) +
  stat_function(fun = model_7_func, color = "#FA7A06", size = 1) +
  geom_text(aes(x = 3.36 - 0.15, y = -5, label = "3.36"), color = "#FA7A06", size = 4) +
  geom_vline(xintercept=3.36, linetype="dashed", color = "#FA7A06", size = 0.5) +
  xlab("Computational MSV") + ylab("Video Engagement (divided by 10,000)") + ggtitle(" ") +
  theme(panel.grid.major = element_blank(), panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), aspect.ratio=0.9, legend.position = "none",
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 15), axis.title.x = element_text(size = 15),
        panel.background = element_blank(), axis.line = element_line(colour = "black"), panel.border = element_rect(colour = "black", fill=NA, size=1))
figure.2b
```

## Tables S22 & Figure 2C & 2D ##
```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
test.1 = fread(here("data/msv_testset_science.csv"), data.table = F)
test.1$engagement = rowSums(test.1[,c("view_count", "likes_count", "comments_count")], na.rm = T)/10000

test.2 = fread(here("data/msv_testset_kid.csv"), data.table = F)
test.2$engagement = rowSums(test.2[,c("view_count", "likes_count", "comments_count")], na.rm = T)/10000

model.t11 = glm.nb(engagement ~ poly(predicted_msv, 2, raw = T), data = test.1) # used for Figure 2c
model.t12 = glm.nb(engagement ~ poly(predicted_msv, 2, raw = T) + timestamp + video_duration, data = test.1) # Table S20, Dataset 1
summary(model.t11)
summary(model.t12)

model.t21 = glm.nb(engagement ~ poly(predicted_msv, 2, raw = T), data = test.2) # used for Figure 2d
model.t22 = glm.nb(engagement ~ poly(predicted_msv, 2, raw = T) + timestamp + video_duration, data = test.2) # Table S20, Dataset 2
summary(model.t21)
summary(model.t22)

model_t11_func <- function(x) {exp(-5.86*(x^2) + 38.35*x - 62.39)}
figure.2c = ggplot(test.1, aes(x=predicted_msv, y=engagement)) + 
  geom_point(color = "#1D4A80", alpha = .3, size = 0.5) +
  stat_function(fun = model_t11_func, color = "#FA7A06", size = 1) +
  geom_text(aes(x = 3.27 + 0.1, y = 0.1, label = "3.27"), color = "#FA7A06", size = 3.5) +
  geom_vline(xintercept=3.27, linetype="dashed", color = "#FA7A06", size = 0.5) + ylim(0, 3) +
  xlab("Computational MSV") + ylab("Video Engagement (divided by 10,000)") + ggtitle(" ") +
  theme(panel.grid.major = element_blank(), panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), aspect.ratio=0.9, legend.position = "none",
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 15), axis.title.x = element_text(size = 15),
        panel.background = element_blank(), axis.line = element_line(colour = "black"), panel.border = element_rect(colour = "black", fill=NA, size=1))
figure.2c
```
